title: Vuber Pulse Touch 510 Smart Battery
description:
The Pulse Touch is a patented smart battery that reads the resistance of the cartridge and automatically adjusts the settings for optimal use. Simply attach your cartridge and start vaping! The Pulse features Vuber’s patented “Never Burn” technology, which tapers the heat as you draw to ensure you get the best-tasting hit every time. The Pulse Touch can also be used while charging!

VUBER PULSE AND VUBER PULSE DROP ALSO AVAILABLE

Product Features:
– Reads the resistance of the cartridge and automatically adjusts the settings for optimal use.
– “Never Burn” technology, tapers the heat as you draw, which allows you to attach any cartridge and be certain you will have the best flavor to vapor experience.
– Suction draw activated.
– Protective magnetic cartridge sleeve, for ultimate cartridge protection.
– 430mAh battery allows for long uses between charging.
– Pass-through micro USB charging lets you use the device even when plugged in to charge.
– Smart battery technology automatically adjusts settings for optimal use

What’s Included:
1 x Pulse Touch Battery
